state.instructions: You review calls handled by an AI phone agent for a UK business. Judge only from the transcript.

transcript.text: Thank you for calling Northwind Energy. How can I help today?
My bill is double what it was last month and I want to talk to someone about it.
I can help with that. Can you give me your account number?
I do not have it to hand. I just want to speak to a person.
I am sorry, I am not able to transfer you right now. You can call back with your account number.

outcome.instructions: How did the call end for the caller?

criteria.resolved: The caller got what they called for
criteria.transferred: The call was handed to a person or another agent
criteria.abandoned: The caller gave up or hung up before the matter was dealt with

needs_followup.instructions: Does someone need to contact this caller again?

caller_sentiment.instructions: The caller's tone by the end of the call

agent_error.instructions: Did the agent give wrong or misleading information?

policy_breach.instructions: Did the agent do something its instructions forbid?

escalation_missed.instructions: Did the caller ask for a human and not get one?

criteria.true: The caller asked for a person and the call ended without a transfer
criteria.false: No request for a person, or the caller was transferred
